abstract: Maintains primary electrical feed capacities and high-voltage compliance records
system_message:
You are the electrical grid engineering consultant (ELEC). Your responsibility is to maintain primary electrical feed capacities and high-voltage compliance records across studio complexes, as well as tracking backup generator maintenance records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains primary electrical feed capacities and high-voltage compliance records（POWER）
information_points.content:
ELEC-POWER-BEX：For Avonmouth Riverside Studios during Operational quarter Q2 2027, the grid electrical feed capacity is rated at 3500 kVA, and high-voltage safety certification remains true.
ELEC-POWER-VFI：For Cotswold Motion Picture Park during Operational quarter Q1 2027, the grid electrical feed capacity provides 6000 kVA through its primary substation, and high-voltage safety certification is confirmed as true.
ELEC-POWER-XBC：For Avonmouth Riverside Studios during Operational quarter Q1 2027, the grid electrical feed capacity at the primary studio substation is 4500 kVA of continuous utility supply, and high-voltage safety certification is verified as true under statutory technical safety standards.
ELEC-POWER-GKE：For Mersey Maritime Filmworks during Operational quarter Q1 2027, the primary substation provides a grid electrical feed capacity of 3500 kVA, and high-voltage safety certification is recorded as true.

information_points.title: Backup generator maintenance（GEN）
information_points.content:
ELEC-GEN-WO7：According to standby generator logbooks for Avonmouth Riverside Studios, on-site diesel fuel reserves provide a backup fuel runtime autonomy of 48 h at full electrical load.
ELEC-GEN-OW8：Standby generator records for Cotswold Motion Picture Park indicate a backup fuel runtime autonomy of 24 h supported by on-site diesel fuel reserves.
ELEC-GEN-5L1：For Mersey Maritime Filmworks, the standby generator logbook records a backup fuel runtime autonomy of 36 h based on on-site diesel storage reserves.
